name: hud_layout_hw_enable
description: HudLayoutHW::Enable resets hardware HUD child and transient widget flags, then dispatches the layout SetEnabled slot with enabled=1.
known_limits: Tier C first; no VC verification target currently covers 0x413540, so tier S acceptance remains deferred to a HUD layout source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x413540 validate SetChildFlags(&g_HudUiMgr, 0x0e), SetChildFlags(this, 0x0e), widget3/objective/sensor flag low-byte masking with 0x10, a message loop over entries 1 through 9 that masks side-widget flags only when the side widget has an image, and an indirect call through the base ftable slot 1 with enabled=1.
The direct callee 0x4bc8d0 HudUiContainer::SetChildFlags is reconstructed, dependency-ready, implemented, and functionally accepted.

The native hardware layout enable smoke installs concrete manager/layout children, objective/sensor/message globals, and a custom ftable slot 1 capture, then verifies flag propagation and masking, message index 0 and null-image message preservation, and the final SetEnabled dispatch with this == layout and enabled == 1.
